title: Wire Raster Wgpu Dev Preview into Launch Config and Verify End to End
description: The `raster` technology (bitmap/layers editing plugin app under raster/rs, raster/plugin/rs) has a working `bun run dev:raster` script and is registered in the generated framework-os playground catalog (framework/plugin/registry/generated/playgrounds.json: variant raster, react port 6060, wgpu port 6160). It already has a `raster-react-dev` entry in .claude/launch.json (port 6060), but unlike note/puzzle2d/shooting/draw etc. it has NO `raster-wgpu-dev` entry — devs can only launch the wgpu variant via CLI, which CLAUDE.md forbids. Register raster-wgpu-dev in .claude/launch.json following the existing note-wgpu-dev/draw-wgpu-dev pairing pattern (name, runtimeExecutable bun, runtimeArgs run dev:raster, env RASTER_PLAY_PORT=6160 + SEMIO_RENDERER=wgpu, port 6160). Then launch both raster-react-dev and raster-wgpu-dev via the preview tooling and verify raster actually works end to end in the browser: the Semio Logo raster example (raster/example/semio.raster.json) loads, layers render on canvas (pixel/adjustment/group), camera pan/zoom works, and at least one tool is interactive with no console errors. framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs already implements SurfaceKind::Raster and render_raster() (region //#region Raster, closed tickets RASTER-FRAMEWORK-INTEGRATION / RASTER-ZOOM-COMPOSITE-FIX say this was working) — confirm it still works post-verification; if wgpu is broken for an unrelated pre-existing reason, note it in the ticket summary without attempting to fix the wgpu renderer itself (out of scope beyond the launch config wiring).
summary:
Registered raster-wgpu-dev (port 6160, SEMIO_RENDERER=wgpu) in .claude/launch.json next to the existing raster-react-dev entry, following the note-wgpu-dev/draw-wgpu-dev pattern.

While verifying raster-react-dev end to end in the browser, found the app crashed on load with "session.setActiveUtility is not a function" (framework/renderer/react/components/raster-host.tsx:195). Root cause: commit #288 (b8e2fcb425) renamed set_active_tool -> set_active_utility in raster/rs/lib.rs (js_name = setActiveUtility), but the local raster/rs/pkg wasm-bindgen build artifact (gitignored, not committed) was stale and still exported setActiveTool. Fixed by rebuilding it: `cd raster/rs && bun ./script.ts wasm`. After the rebuild, the crash is gone and the app loads cleanly with no console errors.

Follow-up found and filed separately (not fixed here, out of scope for launch-config wiring): after the crash fix, selecting the "Semio" example still renders a flat background color on both Composite and Navigator canvases — none of the 8 fixture layers (backdrop, logo-group/semio-emblem, adjustments, vignette) visibly paint, despite document sync and asset upload completing without error and WebGPU initializing successfully. Spawned as a follow-up task for deeper investigation into the Rust compositor / raf render-loop timing.

raster-wgpu-dev could not be fully verified in this session: its cargo build (rebuilding ~30 plugin crates for the shared wgpu renderer binary) ran into extended lock contention with a concurrent dev session that was also actively editing shared repo files (.claude/launch.json, Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock) during this ticket — consistent with prior observed concurrent-workspace-churn behavior in this repo. The launch.json entry is registered and correct; the wgpu preview itself needs a follow-up verification pass once the shared build settles.
